front_blocks.md: Give two benefits of an attached stylesheet.

back_blocks.md: It can be **edited separately from the HTML**, and the **same styles can be reused across multiple pages**.

front_blocks.md: Why are relative file paths used for attached stylesheets?

back_blocks.md: They refer to the location of the CSS file **relative to the current HTML file**, which makes the code **more portable and easier to manage**.

back_blocks.md: An inline stylesheet is written **directly within an HTML tag using the style attribute**, and applies **only to the page it is written into**.

front_blocks.md: What is the cascading order, from highest to lowest priority?

back_blocks.md: **Inline styles** inside an HTML element, then **external and internal styles** in the head section, then the **browser default**.

cards.front_md: What is the cascading order, from highest to lowest priority?
cards.back_md: **Inline styles** inside an HTML element, then **external and internal styles** in the head section, then the **browser default**.

front_blocks.md: An external stylesheet overrides an inline style.

back_blocks.md: The style **closest to the element takes priority**, so an **inline** style overrides the external stylesheet.

cards.front_md:
**True or False?**

An external stylesheet overrides an inline style.
cards.back_md:
**False.**

The style **closest to the element takes priority**, so an **inline** style overrides the external stylesheet.

front_blocks.md: What is the difference between padding and border-spacing?

back_blocks.md: `**padding**` defines the space between the **cell content and its border**, while `**border-spacing**` controls the space **between cells**.
